newsitem.title: UK: Centrica eases on discount scheme.
newsitem.headline: Centrica eases on discount scheme.

text.p: Shares in Centrica Plc eased on Tuesday after the the gas supplier, which was spun off from British Gas last month, introduced a new discount price scheme.
By 0850 GMT, the shares were down 1-1/2p to 62-1/4.
Centrica said it would offer its customers in south west England discounts of up to 12 percent on their bills
"I don't think it's the (discount scheme) that's pressuring the shares," said one analyst. "It's a soggy market and buyers have stepped away."
He said he viewed the move as positive on balance, if regulatory approval could be obtained.
He added it was likely that regulators will issue consultation papers for industry feedback. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
